claims.exact_statement: For arbitrary genuine Boolean g0 and g1 on disjoint uniform input blocks, and a fresh d-bit one-word selector choosing g1 with p=2^-d and g0 otherwise, U(F) is given exactly by equation (2) of SEPARATED_HIERARCHY_PAYMENT.tex. In particular the complete control charge J=U(F)-(1-p)U(g0)-pU(g1) depends on the children only through their endpoint U values and defect rates r0,r1.
hypotheses: g0 and g1 genuine Boolean signs
complete physical variable sets of g0 and g1 disjoint
fresh d-bit control block with one active word
proof_dependencies: direct Walsh and upper-set summation reproduced in this bundle
claims.scope: ONE FRESH SWITCH; DISJOINT SIBLING VARIABLE BLOCKS
does_not_prove: the same formula for overlapping sibling spectra
claims.first_unproved_line: Control the distributional upper-mass interference created by shared child variables.

claims.exact_statement: For every finite rooted physical tree whose internal nodes use fresh one-word control blocks, whose two child subtrees at every node have disjoint complete variable sets, and whose leaves are arbitrary genuine Boolean functions, U(Froot)-sum_leaf w_leaf U(g_leaf) <= C_sep I_sel(Froot), where C_sep=3+4(1+2/e)/ln2+2/ln2+2/(e ln2)<16.964. Every node charge, leaf packet, and selector influence is used once. The constant is independent of depth, activation probabilities, leaf dimensions, leaf spectra, and the number of core changes.
hypotheses: fresh control block at every internal node
disjoint complete variable sets across siblings
adaptive stopping at the first inactive control bit
claims.scope: ARBITRARY DEPTH; FRESH READ-ONCE SEPARATED SIBLING SUBTREES
does_not_prove: whole-set addressing with reused address bits
a bound on arbitrary leaf U without a leaf hypothesis
claims.first_unproved_line: Bound the total positive overlap defect for siblings sharing physical variables without reusing pivotal events.
